parameters.query:
SELECT
     (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS total,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'auto_posted' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS auto_posted,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'approved' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS approved,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'rejected' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS rejected,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending') AS pending_now,
     (SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('auto_posted','approved') AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS value_posted,
     (SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(confidence), 1), 0) FROM invoices WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS avg_confidence,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'duplicate_rejected' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS duplicates,
     (SELECT COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), 0) FROM llm_calls WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS llm_cost,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_errors WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS errors;
